video_title: VJ Edgecombe & Nikola Jović Reveal What It's REALLY Like Playing With NBA LEGENDS | PLYR2PLYR Ep. 3

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jović
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jović on overcoming skepticism about his shooting and scoring ability
quotes.excerpt: everybody thinks he doesn't shoot, he's not going to score, so I thought it was going to be easy

text_blocks.speaker: Nikola Jović
text_blocks.text: Everybody thinks he doesn't shoot, he's not going to score, so I thought it was going to be easy. He gave me problems.

text_blocks.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
text_blocks.text: He made me look really bad.

quotes.social_post: Nikola Jovic admits he underestimated Draymond Green during his rookie year. He says Draymond gave him serious problems with his screens and passing, noting he felt all over the place and looked really bad in that matchup.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on his confidence and playing alongside future Hall of Famers
quotes.excerpt: I'm sharing the floor with future Hall of Famers, if we're being completely honest.
quotes.quote: It's just my style of play and the confidence I have now. I'm sharing the floor with future Hall of Famers, if we're being completely honest.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe says playing alongside future Hall of Famers like Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey has been an amazing experience that has significantly boosted his confidence on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jović
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jović on the significance of playing basketball for his country
quotes.excerpt: It's more than basketball playing for a country.
quotes.quote: It means a lot to me. It's more than basketball playing for a country. I mean, you probably feel the same way.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jovic on the pride of representing his country: It is more than just basketball. He says playing for Serbia means a lot to him and is a sentiment shared by many European players.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on getting dunked on by teammate Dominic Barlow
quotes.excerpt: I got dunked on by my teammate in a game, though. I can't remember who we played.
quotes.quote: I got dunked on by my teammate in a game, though. I can't remember who we played, but Dominic Barlow. He dunked on me on a little fast break off a pull-up back.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe keeps it real about his rookie moments, admitting he got dunked on by his own teammate Dominic Barlow during a fast break.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jović
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jović on his first NBA matchup against Draymond Green
quotes.excerpt: my first year we played in Golden State and my matchup was Draymond Green.
quotes.quote: My first year we played in Golden State and my matchup was Draymond Green. I thought he was going to be really light. He gave me problems. A hand-off keeps, the screens he was setting, the passes he made, I was all over the place. I looked really bad in that game.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jovic reflects on his first game against Draymond Green: I thought he was going to be light, but he gave me problems. He made me look really bad.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on the challenges of growing up internationally
quotes.excerpt: Growing up internationally is lit, being able to grow from it in a different country.
quotes.quote: Growing up internationally is lit, being able to grow from it in a different country, especially living a different lifestyle from America. I enjoyed it, even though it was a little difficult. I feel like that's what made me who I am.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe reflects on his international upbringing, saying that living in a different country and experiencing a different lifestyle from America was difficult but ultimately made him who he is today.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on moving to the United States during the COVID-19 pandemic
quotes.excerpt: I moved to America during 2020, but the whole world was shut down.
quotes.quote: I moved to America during 2020, but the whole world was shut down. I was just playing the game in the house. Life really started for me in America until about 2022.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe shares his experience moving to the United States in 2020, noting that because the world was shut down, his life in America did not really start until 2022.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jović
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jović on the importance of the national team in European basketball
quotes.excerpt: coming from Europe, where we thrive and where all the talk is about the national team.
quotes.quote: Coming from Europe, where we thrive and where all the talk is about the national team, how much it means to us. It's more than basketball playing for a country.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jovic explains the cultural difference in European basketball, highlighting that the national team is the primary focus and holds immense significance for players from that region.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on learning different styles of play from professional teammates
quotes.excerpt: I'm learning so much different things because there's so much different style of play.
quotes.quote: I'm learning so much different things because there's so much different style of play. Obviously, the European style of basketball might be a little different from the NBA style. So I'm learning different styles.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe is focused on growth, noting that he is currently learning to adapt to the different styles of play between European basketball and the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jović
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jović on learning from Nikola Jokić and other Serbian players
quotes.excerpt: I learned a lot, especially from Nikola Jokić, who is one of the best players right now.
quotes.quote: I learned a lot, especially from Nikola Jokić, who is one of the best players right now. Everything he knows how to do, from his routine to his basketball, to the way he plays, the way he does anything, I was trying to learn everything I can from him.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jovic says he tries to learn everything he can from Nikola Jokic, from his daily routine to the way he plays the game, calling him one of the best players in the world right now.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jović
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jović on his relationship with Bogdan Bogdanović
quotes.excerpt: my big brother, you know, Bogie, Bogdan Bogdanović, a legend.
quotes.quote: My big brother, you know, Bogie, Bogdan Bogdanović, a legend. So yeah, it means a lot to me.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jovic calls Bogdan Bogdanovic his big brother and a legend, emphasizing how much his relationship with the fellow Serbian star means to him.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on the impact of playing alongside future Hall of Famers
quotes.excerpt: I'm sharing the floor with future Hall of Famers, if we're being completely honest.
quotes.quote: It's just my style of play and the confidence I have now. I'm sharing the floor with future Hall of Famers, if we're being completely honest. Sharing the floor with Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid, like, it's amazing.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe on sharing the floor with stars like Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey: It is just my style of play and the confidence I have now. Sharing the floor with future Hall of Famers is amazing.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jović
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jović on the veterans who helped him early in his career
quotes.excerpt: Kyle Lowry, who I learned a lot from, and my brother Jimmy Butler.
quotes.quote: Kyle Lowry, who I learned a lot from, and my brother Jimmy Butler. He's the guy who I learned a lot, a lot from. Kevin Love, UD. I was happy I had the chance to spend a year with him.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jovic credits his early development to Heat veterans, specifically mentioning how much he learned from Jimmy Butler, Kyle Lowry, Kevin Love, and Udonis Haslem.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jović
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jović on the value of staying with one organization
quotes.excerpt: I think everybody wants, you know, to be with one team for 20 years.
quotes.quote: For someone like that who's been with the same organization for 20 years, I think everybody wants, you know, to be with one team for 20 years and be on top of the world. He won three titles, you know, so I had some great people around me.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jovic reflects on the career of Udonis Haslem, noting that everyone wants to be with one organization for 20 years and reach the top of the world like he did.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jović
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jović on the atmosphere of playing in Denver
quotes.excerpt: we were in the finals against Denver, so Denver is an interesting one.
quotes.quote: We were in the finals against Denver, so Denver is an interesting one. I think their fan base is pretty cool. Philly is a good one always, because of the fans.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jovic shares his thoughts on NBA fan bases, noting that Denver has a cool atmosphere and Philly is always a tough place to play because of the fans.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on the toughness required to play in Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: You got to be a real tough person to play in Philly, bro.
quotes.quote: Obviously they call the city Brotherly Love. Only certain people can play in Philly, though. You got to be a real tough person to play in Philly, bro. Because you can have a bad game, you're going to hear it. They're going to tell you about it. You have a good game, they're going to love you.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe on the Philly fan base: Only certain people can play in Philly. You have to be a real tough person because if you have a bad game, you are going to hear about it.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jović
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jović on the international diversity of Miami
quotes.excerpt: Miami as a city, there's so many international people, so you don't feel like you're exactly in America.
quotes.quote: Miami as a city, there's so many international people, so you don't feel like you're exactly in America all the time, you know, especially because they speak a lot of Spanish there, more than English. So it's the first thing that kind of caught me.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jovic says the international diversity of Miami makes it feel like you are not exactly in America all the time, especially with how much Spanish is spoken in the city.
